description.value:
Cost 2 Encore

Traits Signal, auditory

You spend 2 Encore and replay the previous 6 seconds of sound — the last round — audibly to every creature in range, exactly as it occurred. It reproduces sound and nothing else: no images, no thoughts, no unspoken intentions. It is not an illusion and cannot be disbelieved or counteracted. It provides no bonus to any check, though what it proves is often worth more than a bonus.

cinderfall.incomplete: Per P11: the only mechanical content is the Encore cost (SB1); the payload is explicitly narrative even before that blocker is reached. No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either.
